title: Stripe subscription integration kickoff
description: The original meeting_notes.txt both implementations ship with. Standard engineering planning meeting: three participants, clear workstreams, explicit technical detail (tiers, webhook events). Baseline recall/quality case.

expected_tasks.name: Configure subscription tiers in Stripe
key_points: three tiers: Basic $29/month, Pro $49/month, Enterprise $99/month
tiers must be reflected correctly in the app (functionality and UX)

expected_tasks.name: Build checkout flow with Stripe Elements
key_points: use Stripe Elements for the checkout form
form styling must match the app's design
handle errors gracefully (invalid card details, insufficient funds)

expected_tasks.name: Update pricing page for new subscription tiers
key_points: show the three new tiers with a clear feature comparison
prominent checkout button
tooltip/help icon explaining what happens when switching plans later

expected_tasks.name: Build subscription management into the user dashboard
key_points: show current plan details and billing info
upgrade, downgrade, and cancel options
access to invoices and payment history
update payment methods
real-time subscription status and notifications for changes (upgrades, payment failures)

expected_tasks.name: Integrate Stripe API on the backend
key_points: create subscriptions when a user selects a plan and pays
process successful and failed payments

expected_tasks.name: Implement Stripe webhook handlers
key_points: handle invoice.payment_succeeded to confirm payment and activate/continue the subscription
handle invoice.payment_failed with user notification and prompt to update payment info (consider email)
handle customer.subscription.deleted to update access rights and offer re-subscription
test the handlers thoroughly, simulating failures and cancellations

expected_tasks.name: Prepare and execute a subscription test plan
key_points: detailed test plan shared with the team
manual and automated tests
cover the whole flow: sign-up, billing, managing the subscription, edge cases

expected_tasks.name: Write user documentation and support content
key_points: user instructions for managing subscriptions, accessing invoices, handling issues
help section / FAQ for common subscription questions
internal docs for API endpoints and webhook handlers

acceptable_extras: schedule/hold the follow-up meeting next week
frontend-backend integration coordination as its own task
two-week integration + one-week testing timeline as a milestone task
user notifications for subscription events split out from the dashboard task
